title: 2026 Neets Bay Terminal Harvest Area Fisheries Announcement

CONTACT: Bo Meredith Ketchikan Area Management Biologist bo.meredith@alaska.gov (907) 225-5195

2026 NEETS BAY TERMINAL HARVEST AREA FISHERIES ANNOUNCEMENT

The Neets Bay Terminal Harvest Area will close to rotational net fisheries beginning at 5:01 a.m., Friday, August 21, 2026. The Southern Southeast Regional Aquaculture Association has begun securing coho salmon broodstock at the Neets Bay release site.

The Emergency Order corresponding to this announcement is EO 1E2926.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
